content.title: Use the publishing CTAs on the home page to reach the packages page
content.intent: Prove that each home-page publishing call to action that promises the publishing packages page takes the visitor to `/publish`.
content.technique_notes: Applied equivalence partitioning to the two publishing controls with the same promised outcome: `Start Publishing` and `Compare all packages →`. Kept as one scenario with equivalent-control variation because the outcome does not change. No covering-array expansion applied because there is only one equivalence family on this path. Budget rank 2/4 because these CTAs are primary public conversion routes into the author flow.
